answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The nebula lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the garden is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The bridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit.
